Name: Recipes for Dutch Pancakes
Author: Darcy91
Description:
[center][quote]What are Dutch Pancakes??[/quote]﻿[/center]
Dutch pancakes are often confused for crepes. Whilst also thin, Dutch pancakes are slightly thicker and larger. Additionally, the toppings aren't necessarily toppings as such, but are baked in during the baking process. 
People make these at home, but there are also lots of Pancake Restaurants found all over the Netherlands. Several of them are located in houseboats. These restaurants are popular among all age groups, and are often a prime location for kids parties. 


[quote][center]What to find in the mod﻿:[/center][/quote]
This mod adds (for now) 22 different pancake recipes, all of which are based on existing pancakes one can order in above mentioned restaurants. Since the base-game is limited in the items provided that are suitable for the mod, I added Raffadax' amazing mod as a dependency since it has basically everything one could need. The recipes are known from the start, so no need to befriend anyone or wait for a specific date. However, some of the ingredients are not easily obtainable early on, so it is still something to work towards in the later stages of the game. 

[quote] ﻿﻿[center]NEW: PPJA version instead of Raffadax version.﻿[/center][/quote]
I've heard from many people that they find Raffadax too intimidating / too large, but still want to try out some pancakes. For you folks, there is now a PPJA version instead. It is slightly different since not all of the same ingredients are available, but the flavours are still there. For the most "authentic" experience I recommend getting the Raffadax version, but now you at least have the option not to. 
[b]

[quote][center]Future changes:[/center][/quote]
In the future I will try and add more recipes. Specifically more dessert type recipes (yes, ice cream on pancakes is a thing!), and a meat-based one. The latter will have a new dependency, I will look and see if I make Raffadax a dependency as well. Time will tell.

[quote][center]Feedback:[/center][/quote]
As this is my first mod, feedback is always welcome. If you found any errors, have suggestions or questions, please let me know and I will take a look!

[quote][center]Translations: [/center][/quote]
If you want to provide a translation I don't mind, but please shoot me a message first (here or on Discord: Darcy#7812).
